Xiaomi battery advice

MIUI and HyperOS may restrict background operation. In app settings, look for Battery saver and choose No restrictions if available. You may also need to allow background autostart. Names and availability vary by device.

Key Viewer cannot verify these manufacturer settings. Opening settings or continuing does not confirm that restrictions are disabled. You can continue without changing them.

Start the overlay first. Auto-show works when a selected app is in the foreground and the device is in landscape. With no apps selected, nothing is shown automatically; manual notification controls remain available. After saving, switch apps or rotate the device for auto-show to update.
